## Import Dataset

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
student_risk <- read_csv("student_dropout_risk_2026.csv")
is.tibble(student_risk)

View(student_risk)
```

## EDA

Converting 0/1 variables to Yes/No variables and forcing all categorical variables to be factors, including imposing ordering on family income level.

```{r}
student_risk <- student_risk |>
  mutate(
    across(
      c(
        first_generation,
        tuition_up_to_date,
        disability_status,
        scholarship_holder,
        part_time_job,
        international_student,
        dropout
      ),
      ~ factor(.x,
               levels = c(0, 1),
               labels = c("No", "Yes"))
    ),
    
    across(
      c(gender, nationality, course_type, study_mode),
      as.factor
    ),
    
    family_income_level = factor(
      family_income_level,
      levels = c("Low", "Middle", "High"),
      ordered = TRUE
    )
  )
```

### Categorical Tables and Summaries

Determine how many variables have missing values. There are not any missing values in this data set.

```{r}
colSums(is.na(student_risk))
```

View the number of responses for each level of the categorical variables.

```{r}
lapply(
  student_risk |>  select(where(is.factor)),
  table
)
```

Create two way tables to examine relationships in the data.

```{r}
#examine gender and nationality
table(student_risk$gender, student_risk$nationality)

#examine scholarship status and family income level
prop.table(table(student_risk$family_income_level, student_risk$scholarship_holder))

#examine scholarship status, family income, and gender
prop.table(
  table(student_risk$family_income_level, student_risk$scholarship_holder, student_risk$gender))

#examine course of study and dropout
prop.table(
  table(student_risk$course_type, student_risk$dropout)
)

#examine study mode and dropout
prop.table(
  table(student_risk$study_mode, student_risk$dropout))

#examine dropout by gender
prop.table(table(student_risk$gender))

#examine study course of study, gender and dropout
prop.table(
  table(student_risk$course_type, student_risk$dropout, student_risk$gender)
)
```
